modules.title: Distributed System

Leader election algorithm- Bully algorithm, Ring algorithm. Termination detection- Spanning tree-based algorithm.

modules.title: Parallel Computing

Basic Communication operations: One to All Broadcast and All to One Reduction, All to All Broadcast and Reduction, All Reduce

modules.topics: Principles of Message Passing Programming, The building blocks: Send and Receive Operations, MPI: The Message Passing Interface, Overlapping Communication with Computation, Collective Communication and Computation Operations, Groups and Communicators.
